overview_description.description:
Recruitment platform that helps Arab women connect to sales and employment opportunities from the comfort of their home. 

As a social startup we get motivated by challenging the social-economical barriers most women face in the Middle East when wanting to pursue a career. Women make the best employable resources in the Arab world, however they are no where to be seen in the marketplace in comparison to their male counterparts. Employment rate in MENA is at 24% according to ILO estimates. SitatByoot provide the necessary tools to HR departments in order to motivate them to hire women working from home.
